text:
Alex G.: quick design sync: aiming for a keyboard-first API keys table + clearer microcopy. Figma: https://figma.com/s/keyflow-kbd-first
Priya (PM): Main goals: reduce accidental revokes, make rotate painless, and ensure screen-reader clarity. Also tighten create-copy so users don't lose secrets.
Marta (design): Proposed pattern: table rows support Enter to expand, Arrow keys to navigate rows, and single-key shortcuts (c = create, r = rotate when focused, d = disable). Expansion shows compact metadata: last-used, permission pills, short masked secret hint.
Devon (eng): Implementation notes: shortcuts must be discoverable (hover ? or help modal). Backend needs an API to request "soft-rotate" vs "hard-revoke". Soft-rotate: new secret created with overlap window; hard-revoke: immediate invalidation.
Kai (a11y): A11y checklist: when row expands announce "Key details for <name> expanded" via aria-live=polite. Shortcuts need an accessible cheat sheet reachable by ? that is focusable and has role="dialog".
Marta (design): Copy for create modal: header "Create API key" body: "Secret shown once. Download now or store in your vault." Primary CTA: "Download secret"; secondary: "Copy to clipboard". Add subtle hint: "Default: read-only" and a toggle to choose elevated scopes.
Priya (PM): Revoke UX: avoid scary permanent language inline. Inline action = "Disable" with amber token; full destructive action in details drawer = "Revoke permanently" with type-to-confirm. Confirm copy: "Revoking will immediately stop any clients using this key. To avoid downtime, consider rotating instead." Suggest shorter alt for confirm: "This will stop clients using this key immediately. Revoke anyway?"
Devon (eng): Edge: add "session-safe revoke" option that invalidates tokens but also issues a migration token for 24h to help rolling updates. Backend will emit an audit event when used.
Kai (a11y): When new secret is revealed, ensure it receives focus and is in a role=region with aria-label "new secret". After 30s or on close, remove it from DOM so SRs don't keep it. Toasts for copy must use role="status".
Marta (design): Empty state copy suggestion (different tone): "No credentials yet — generate a dev token to try things out. Tip: start read-only and rotate before promoting to prod." Include a tiny one-line quickstart snippet and a keyboard hint "Press c to create".
Priya (PM): Permission visibility: show compact matrix in expansion: who created it, last rotated, assigned scopes. For admin-scoped keys show a red-outline pill "Admin (audited)" with tooltip describing audit requirements.
Devon (eng): Telemetry in-row: last used timestamp, last IP (masked), and small sparkline. Limit IPs to last 5 and mask middle bytes.
ci-bot: deploy:preview #kbd-first-keyflow -> https://preview.redwood.ai/kbd-keys (preview build succeeded)
Alex G.: thanks all. Marta will update mocks with keyboard cheat sheet and revised copy. Kai will run the SR walkthrough on preview. If no objections I'll ship behind a feature flag next week. :thumbsup:
Priya (PM): Sounds good. Minor copy edit: change "generate" to "create" in empty state for consistency.
Marta (design): Will do, posting new figma link by EOD.
